title: Compat API v1.55: image attestations and update per-device blkio
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.55](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v155-api-changes) has two Compat gaps that must land before we can claim v1.55 under the parent epic.
## Needs work
### 1. `GET /images/{name}/attestations`
- New endpoint; not registered today.
- Query params:
  - `platform` (repeatable; only one value currently accepted; defaults to host platform)
  - `type` (repeatable; filter by in-toto predicate type URI)
  - `statement` (bool; default `false` = descriptor + PredicateType only; `true` includes statement body)
- Response: JSON array of `AttestationStatement` objects.
### 2. `POST /containers/{id}/update` per-device blkio
- Apply `BlkioWeightDevice`, `BlkioDeviceReadBps`, `BlkioDeviceWriteBps`, `BlkioDeviceReadIOps`, `BlkioDeviceWriteIOps`.
- Today Compat update only handles scalar `BlkioWeight`; create already maps the per-device fields.
- Semantics: omit/`null` = leave unchanged; empty array = clear that rule set.
- OCI `LinuxBlockIO` already has the corresponding WeightDevice / Throttle* fields.
## Checklist
- [ ] `GET /images/{name}/attestations` (`platform`, `type`, `statement`)
- [ ] Update per-device blkio fields with omit/null vs empty-array semantics
## Contributing
If you want to work on one checklist item, please open a focused issue and PR for that part and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Prefer one change area per PR so attestations and blkio update can land independently.
